school-print-12bed580.context: A school drama club and a printer must arrange one run of illustrated programs. Negotiate the package price, production window and proofing service.

turns.speaker: Buyer
turns.text:
Could you do $900 all in, with a paper proof for the students to review and the finished programs ready for collection in four days?
Action: offer | USD 900 | schedule: four days | service: paper proof

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.text:
Thanks for the clear request. Four days is workable, but $900 with a paper proof is below what I can run this job for. A physical proof means a separate press setup and a courier run, so it is the expensive part of your request.

A digital proof is far cheaper for me to provide. The students would get a full-colour PDF of every page that they can review together on a screen and mark up the same day, which also protects your four-day timeline better than waiting on a hard copy.

So I propose $1,020 for four days with a digital proof. If the paper proof is essential, I can do it at $1,085 on the same schedule. If your date has any give, tell me, and I can see what a one-week window does for the price.
Action: offer | USD 1020 | schedule: four days | service: digital proof

turns.speaker: Buyer
turns.text:
A full-colour PDF works for us. We can have the students return one set of comments the day it arrives. With that turnaround, could you do $960 all in, with the programs ready for collection in four days?
Action: offer | USD 960 | schedule: four days | service: digital proof

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.text:
Good, a single set of comments returned the same day makes the four-day window straightforward, and I appreciate you moving. Let's split the remaining gap: $990 all in, with the digital proof and the programs ready for collection in four days. If that works for you, we're done and I can book the press slot today.
Action: offer | USD 990 | schedule: four days | service: digital proof

turns.speaker: Buyer
turns.text:
Agreed. We’ll pay $990 all in for the digital proof and the finished programs ready for collection in four days. We’ll return one set of comments the day we receive the proof. Please book the press slot.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.text:

turns.speaker: Buyer
turns.text:

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.text:
Can we meet halfway at $960? That includes a digital proof for the students to approve before we print, with the programs ready for pickup in four days.

turns.speaker: Buyer
turns.text:
Meeting halfway is fair. $960 for four days with a digital proof works for us. We accept, and thank you. The students will turn the proof around quickly so you can stay on schedule.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.text:

The format of the proof is where there's room to trade. A paper proof means a separate physical press setup and is the expensive piece for me. A digital proof is far easier, and the students can still check every page, illustration and name before we run, so you're still protected against correction charges. The four-day window works for my shop without rush overtime, so I'm happy to keep it and you'll have the programs ahead of dress rehearsal. My proposal is four days with a digital proof at $1,010. If the paper proof is essential, I can do it, but it would be about $60 more than that. Which matters more to you, the physical proof or the lower price?

turns.speaker: Buyer
turns.text:

Since dropping the paper proof removes the separate press setup, which you said is the expensive piece, I'd ask you to meet me at $930 for four days with a digital proof. If you can do that, we have a deal and I can get the files to you straight away.
Action: offer | USD 930 | schedule: four days | service: digital proof

turns.speaker: Seller

I do want to make this work for a school club, so I'll come down to $975 for four days with a digital proof. That includes the students' review of the proof before anything goes to press, so you're not exposed to correction charges. If that works, send the files over and I'll get the proof to you right away.
Action: offer | USD 975 | schedule: four days | service: digital proof

turns.speaker: Buyer
